run_microbenchmark_latency: run the microbenchmark script with --collect latency to generate latency profiles for gRPC benchmarks
run_microbenchmark_perf: run the microbenchmark script with --collect perf to generate flamegraphs using perf recording
run_microbenchmark_summary: run the microbenchmark script with --collect summary to collect benchmark summary results in JSON format
run_microbenchmark_bigquery: run the microbenchmark script with --bigquery_upload to upload summary results to Google BigQuery
run_microbenchmark_selective: run the microbenchmark script with -b to target specific benchmarks and --summary_time to set minimum run time
